reading: The value of the clinic depends on a chain that is not yet observed: whether eligible patients actually reach the clinic, whether the nurses deliver titration and self-care as planned, whether that changes readmissions and quality of life, and what the clinic costs per patient. The clinic changed its model twice, so even its own history mixes three versions. With no retrieved evidence, every link must be measured locally before a cost per QALY can mean anything.
